## Summary

**Successfully extracted invoice line items and performed reconciliation!**

### Commands Used:

1. **`uv run --offline --no-sync --project /opt/demo python extract_invoices.py`** - Extracted all line items from 3 invoices (002071, 002082, 002093) and performed reconciliation

### Results:

**items.csv** (16 line items extracted):
- ✅ Invoice 002071: 4 items from Delta Studio Supply
- ✅ Invoice 002082: 6 items from Elm Fabrication Ltd (including multi-line description properly concatenated)
- ✅ Invoice 002093: 6 items from Firth Survey Services
- ✅ Credits and discounts included as negative amounts (-9.80, -36.00, -26.00)
- ✅ Exact decimal amounts preserved
- ✅ Complete descriptions including continuation text

**reconciliation.csv**:
- ✅ Invoice 002071: **matched** (difference: 0.00)
- ✅ Invoice 002082: **matched** (difference: 0.00)
- ⚠️ Invoice 002093: **discrepancy** (difference: -0.02)
  - Printed total: 866.26
  - Computed total: 866.24
  - Likely a rounding difference in the original invoice

### Verification:
- All source PDFs remain unchanged (verified via checksums)
- All subtotals computed from line items match printed subtotals
- Two invoices reconcile perfectly; one has a $0.02 rounding discrepancy
- No table headings, subtotals, or tax lines included as items
